scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Global optimal second-largest eigenvalue modulus and all automorphism-invariant minimizers for the symmetric stochastic problem on complete tripartite graphs with two equally sized vertex parts; no claim of unrestricted optimizer uniqueness. Every unrestricted optimizer excludes all edges between the two equal parts once \(q\ge4p\), and every optimum uses at least one before \(q=2p\).
scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: Included Python checker; exact rational checks plus separate LP optimizations and full stochastic eigensystems; finite checking not used to infer infinite-family statement.
limitations: Uniform stationary distribution and symmetric nonnegative row stochastic kernels only.
The balanced case is classical; novelty is the full imbalanced phase classification and optimizer intervals.
Literature comparison is bounded by available indexed and inspectable sources; independent audit is not performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Convex graph-automorphism averaging, full Laplacian-mode decomposition, sharp linear lower bounds, and exact interval feasibility.

title: Exact fastest mixing and edge-orbit transitions on tripartite graphs with two equal parts
